selection_rule: Among round1 candidates passing strict main gates on development choose smallest clean group-macro RMSE. No validation results viewed in this iteration before this selection.
qualification: Development scalar distance worsens by about 0.226%; fault RMSE by about 0.00223%. Both are below the unchanged main limits. Four development recovery failures and 46 fault false-stop samples exist in both versions and are not hidden.
validation_selection_policy: Confirm this fixed implementation and profile once on all 19 existing validation bags; do not retune after observing those results. Reproduction runs are allowed, not new model selection.
